summary: Add a get_jobs_for(func) lookup so callers can find and cancel jobs by function without holding Job objects. Only an initial code exploration is recorded so far.
narrative: The owner asked for a way to look up jobs that run a given function, with tests, because they keep holding Job objects only to cancel them later. Memory holds one observation: the scheduler already exposes tag-based job lookup but has no function-based lookup. No implementation, tests, PR or release is recorded yet, so the request is at the exploration stage.

milestones.text: Explored the scheduler and found tag-based lookup exists but no function-based lookup.
